finalText:
**It's a small JSON API in plain Node — five files, no dependencies.**

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  s["server.js"] -->|checks token| a["auth.js"]
  s --> r["routes.js"]
  r -->|reads| c["cache.js"] --> st["store.js"]
  r -->|writes| st
```

- `server.js` checks the bearer token, then hands off. No token means 401.
- `auth.js` signs and verifies HMAC tokens shaped `userId.signature`.
- `routes.js` maps three routes: get a user, list orders, add an order.
- `cache.js` is a 256-entry LRU sitting in front of every read.
- `store.js` is an in-memory map. Records expire 15 minutes after a write.

**One thing to watch.** The comment in `routes.js` says writes clear the cache. They don't. A new order never clears the cached `orders:` list. The cache has no expiry either, so that stale list can outlive the store's own 15 minutes.
